subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: GR3 'Literal-1 or the data item referenced by identifier-2 specifies a delimiter' (cite.py --check -> OK 14.9.48.4 3)). The binder binds each DELIMITED BY operand (literal, figurative, data item or function-identifier) as a BoundUnstringDelimiter value; the emitter renders its character content (a field's full content, trailing spaces included) as the delimiter string. Goldens: da4_function_sending_operand (DELIMITED BY " " literal and FUNCTION LOWER-CASE("L") identifier), pb979_unstring_receiver_size ("," / ";"). Probes p2/p1 exercised literal and identifier delimiters.
